title: Shopper Support Academy — The Offer Tolerance on Cartwise Shopper Batches Shown-Pay Claims
content:
The claim offer tolerance subtracted in a shown-pay claim on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch follows the shopper's contractor account in Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts:

- **nothing** for a shopper account at the Gold level or above (Full-Service Shopper Gold, Platinum or Diamond) that is **36 or more** whole calendar months past its first activation date;
- **0.25** for an account at the Silver level or above (Silver, Gold, Platinum or Diamond) that is **12 to 35** whole calendar months past its first activation date;
- **0.50** for every other account.

## Training questions

**Which records decide it?** The account's level and its first activation date on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record, with the months counted as whole calendar months up to the handling date.

**A Gold account 20 months past activation?** It is Silver-or-above and within 12 to 35 months: 0.25.

**A Silver account 48 months past activation?** It is not Gold-or-above, and 48 is outside 12 to 35: 0.50.

**A Full-Service Shopper account 60 months past activation?** Below Silver: 0.50.

**A Diamond account exactly 36 whole months past activation?** Nothing is subtracted.
